review_candidates.description: Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite , a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo. Headquartered in Long Beach, California , and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy. Vast is looking for a Senior IT System Administrator , reporting to the System Administrator Manager, to support the development of the systems that will be required for the design and build of human-rated space stations. As a Senior IT System Administrator, you will be responsible for the management, support, and enhancement of the IT infrastructure, IT service delivery, and end-user IT experience. This role ensures the reliable operation and performance of our IT infrastructure and solutions for the site and beyond, playing a pivotal role in managing and overseeing IT systems. You will install and maintain user endpoint devices and support infrastructure managed by other IT teams while training users on complex systems and computer functions. This will be a full-time , exempt position located in our Long Beach location. Responsibilities Enterprise Infrastructure Architecture & Design Design, architect, and implement enterprise-scale Windows Server infrastructure (2016/2019/2022) supporting 500+ endpoints and mission-critical operations. Lead the architecture and optimization of Active Directory Domain Services, including multi-forest/multi-domain design, trust relationships, site topology, and replication strategies. Design and implement Group Policy architecture at scale, including inheritance models, WMI filtering, security filtering, and loopback processing. Advanced Identity & Access Management Architect and maintain complex Active Directory environments, including forest/domain design, schema modifications, FSMO role management, and disaster recovery strategies. Design and enforce role-based access control (RBAC), privileged access management (PAM), and least-privilege security models. Optimize Active Directory performance including replication monitoring, database maintenance, and tombstone management. Enterprise Endpoint & Device Management Architect and manage enterprise endpoint solutions using Group Policy, Configuration Manager (SCCM), and endpoint management platforms Develop comprehensive endpoint security baselines aligned with CIS benchmarks, NIST 800-53, and CMMC requirements. Provide architectural guidance for cross-platform management (macOS via JAMF, Linux) in heterogeneous environments. Patch Management & Compliance Engineering Design and implement enterprise patch management architecture for servers and endpoints. Manage patch ring strategies, pilot groups, and phased deployment models to minimize operational risk. Coordinate patching schedules across production, staging, and development environments. Minimum Qualifications 4+ years of experience in IT system administration in an enterprise environment. 4+ years of experience with endpoint management tools (e.g., JAMF, Intune, GPO). Demonstrable experience in patch management across diverse environments. Solid understanding of server operating systems (Windows Server, Linux) and virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V). Experience with scripting languages like PowerShell, Python, or Bash for task automation and installation. Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (subnets, VLANs, routing). Preferred Skills & Experience Proficiency in administering and managing endpoint and server automation systems. Hands-on experience with enterprise-grade patch management tools (e.g., WSUS, Ivanti, or Automox). Strong understanding of SaaS solutions and their integration into existing IT infrastructure. Experience working within regulatory frameworks (ITAR, NIST, FedRAMP) and maintaining compliance. Proven ability to independently manage complex IT projects with cross-functional impact. Additional Requirements Willingness to work evenings and/or weekends to support critical mission milestones Ability to lift up to 25lbs unassisted Pay Range: California $123,000—$180,000 USD We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply. Compensation And Benefits Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee & onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast’s ongoing commitment to providing high-quality meals for employees. This status includes U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), and asylees and refugees with such status granted, not pending. review_candidates.title: Networks Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description: Zachary Piper Solutions is seeking a Network Systems Engineer to support a large-scale Department of Defense enterprise network program supporting one of the world's largest intranet environments. This position is on-site in Pearl Harbor, HI (PRLH) , with alternate locations available in Whidbey Island, WA (WHDB) or Norfolk, VA (NRFK) . The Network Systems Engineer will serve as a senior technical resource responsible for enterprise network engineering, Tier III troubleshooting, configuration management, and network modernization initiatives across a geographically dispersed environment. Join a mission-critical team supporting secure and reliable network operations that directly impact national defense and global military communications. Responsibilities for the Network Systems Engineer include: Lead troubleshooting, analysis, and resolution of complex enterprise network issues across LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, VPN, and network boundary environments. Configure, maintain, and support routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, VLANs, and network security infrastructure. Develop Engineering Implementation Plans (EIPs), manage change requests, conduct root cause analysis, and support enterprise network deployments. Maintain configuration baselines, ensure DISA STIG compliance, and conduct lab validation testing for upgrades, patches, and configuration changes. Participate in Agile/SAFe ceremonies, collaborate with engineering teams, and support future-state network architecture and modernization efforts. Required Qualifications for the Network Systems Engineer include: 8+ years of professional experience with enterprise network engineering, troubleshooting, and operations support within large-scale environments. Extensive experience supporting LAN/WAN/WLAN, routing, switching, SD-WAN, MPLS, VPNs, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, multicast, firewalls, and network security technologies. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, configuration management, and problem-solving skills with experience providing Tier III escalation support. Bachelor's degree with 8-12 years of relevant experience or Master's degree with 6-10 years of relevant experience. Active Secret Security Clearance required; must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance. DoD 8570 IAT Level III certification (CASP+, CISSP, CCNP Security, or equivalent). Cisco CCNA, CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent network vendor certification required. review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Dominion Energy is committed to providing reliable, affordable, and increasingly clean energy that powers our customers every day. If you want to work for a purpose-driven company that values safety and collaboration, we’re looking for you. You won’t just find a job here; you’ll find your career. Review the position below and apply today . We offer a hybrid work schedule (one week in the office, one week of teleworking) to accommodate the need for flexibility. Military service members and veterans with ranks from E5-E9, W1-CW5, or O3-O6, plus appropriate equivalent combination of education and years of experience as outlined below will be considered for this opportunity. At this time, Dominion Energy cannot transfer or sponsor a work visa or employment authorization for this position. This position does not offer relocation assistance. Job Summary Dominion Energy is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to support telecommunications transport systems and the tools used to monitor, manage, maintain, and restore critical infrastructure services. This role supports high-availability telecommunications environments, including DWDM, MPLS, microwave, optical transport, routing, switching, and related monitoring, inventory, automation, and recovery platforms. The role helps maintain reliable communications services that support critical utility operations. This role mentors team members, provides guidance, and promotes team development. Responsibilities Provide advanced operational support for telecommunications transport systems and associated management platforms. Support production system health, planned maintenance, service restoration, software patching, firmware upgrades, lifecycle activities, turn-ups, decommissions, and recovery readiness. Troubleshoot complex service issues, support escalations, follow established standards and procedures, and help improve monitoring accuracy, documentation, backup validation, and operational reporting. Provide mentorship and operational guidance to less-experienced team members by sharing knowledge, reinforcing standard procedures, and helping build the skills needed to support the environment effectively. Candidates for this role may be located in the Richmond, VA, or Cayce, SC area . Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Experience The knowledge, skills, abilities and experiences that are required for entry into this job include the following: 5 + years of experience preferably of one or more years of telecommunications, network operations, infrastructure operations, or transport network support experience. Experience in telecommunications operations, transport network support, infrastructure operations, network operations, or a related technical field. Experience supporting transport network technologies such as MPLS, DWDM, optical transport, microwave, routing, switching, Layer 2 / Layer 3 services, or other high-availability network services. Experience supporting network monitoring, management, automation, service management, or inventory platforms such as Nokia NSP / NFM-P / NFM-T, SolarWinds, Circuit Vision, ServiceNow, or similar tools. Strong troubleshooting, incident response, change management, documentation, communication, vendor coordination, cross-functional support, mentorship, and knowledge-transfer skills. Ability to work effectively in a critical infrastructure environment, support planned maintenance activities, and follow operational procedures. Ability to work as team member and lead/coordinate activities across technical teams, business partners, vendors, and operational support groups, with a focus on ownership, sound judgment, clear communication, and service reliability. Preferred Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Experience Experience with utility telecommunications networks, transport operations, and legacy TDM services and equipment. Experience with telecommunications management and monitoring platforms such as Nokia NSP / NFM, Ciena MCP, SEL EMS, SEL ICON, SolarWinds, Circuit Vision, ServiceNow, or similar tools. Experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux or similar Linux distributions, command-line troubleshooting, system patching, vulnerability remediation, log review, and backup validation. Knowledge of monitoring and alerting practices, operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, maintenance coordination, disaster recovery readiness, patch governance, lifecycle management, and vendor-supported production environments. Exposure to scripting, APIs, service orchestration, or intent-based networking when used to improve operational efficiency, monitoring accuracy, or service restoration. Additional valued skills include attention to detail, strong troubleshooting ability, sound judgment under pressure, teamwork, clear communication, and the ability to work independently. Education Requirements Bachelor’s degree in information technology, telecommunications, engineering, computer science, operations technology, or a related discipline preferred. Equivalent combination of education, technical training, operational experience, and relevant hands-on support experience may be considered. Licenses, Certifications, And Qualifications Relevant network, telecommunications, cybersecurity, infrastructure operations, service management, automation, or vendor certifications preferred but not required. Examples may include Cisco, Nokia, Ciena, CompTIA, ITIL, Linux, or other industry-recognized certifications applicable to transport systems, monitoring platforms, incident response, change management, automation, or infrastructure operations. Working Conditions Office Work Environment 76 -100% Travel Up to 25% Supports a high-availability critical infrastructure environment. May require on-call rotation, planned maintenance windows, outage response, storm duty, and after-hours support for critical incidents or business needs. Storm duty may require extended schedules and multiple overnight stays based on event duration, restoration needs, and business requirements. Export Control Certain positions at Dominion Energy may involve access to information and technology subject to export controls under U.S. law. Compliance with these export controls may result in Dominion Energy limiting its consideration of certain applicants. What You'll Get Expected Hiring Base Salary Range: $90,900 - $118,100 The expected hiring base salary range is the range we anticipate hiring within for this position. The actual salary offered may vary based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, skills, experience, and work location. This is not intended to represent the full salary range for the position or limit future compensation growth. At Dominion Energy, we offer excellent plans and programs for employees. Employees are rewarded with a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package which includes: health, dental, and vision benefits with coverage for families and domestic partners, vacation, retirement plans including 401k contributions and matches, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement, bonus eligibility, sick leave, and disability insurance. To learn more about our benefits, click here: dombenefits.com. Dominion Energy is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin and/or status as a protected veteran or individual with a disability. You can experience the excitement of our company – it's the difference between taking a job and starting a career.

review_candidates.title: Sr. Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description: Meet the Moment with Alteryx We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation. You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible. If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here. The Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer designs, builds, and operates the cloud platforms that support Alteryx products and engineering teams. This role focuses on scalable infrastructure, automation, reliability, security, and the modernization of legacy systems across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. You will lead infrastructure initiatives from technical design through production deployment, working closely with Product Engineering, SRE, Security, Networking, Compliance, and other platform teams. You will also help simplify existing infrastructure, reduce manual operational work, and establish reusable patterns that make cloud services easier to deploy and support. The ideal candidate is an experienced cloud engineer who can work independently, make sound technical decisions, troubleshoot complex distributed systems, and guide other engineers through design and implementation challenges. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain secure, reliable, and scalable cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform, Terragrunt, and reusable infrastructure modules. Build and support Kubernetes-based platforms using technologies such as Amazon EKS, Google Kubernetes Engine, Helm, Argo CD, and service mesh technologies. Develop and improve CI/CD workflows using GitLab CI/CD and related deployment automation. Lead the migration of legacy infrastructure, applications, and operational processes to modern cloud-native architectures. Refactor large or tightly coupled infrastructure implementations into smaller, maintainable, and independently deployable components. Automate cloud account provisioning, access controls, network configuration, secrets management, platform upgrades, and infrastructure lifecycle operations. Support cloud networking capabilities, including load balancing, DNS, ingress, and service discovery. Implement secure identity and access patterns using cloud IAM, workload identity, role-based access control, Teleport, and centralized secrets management services. Investigate complex infrastructure and application issues across cloud services, Kubernetes clusters, virtual machines, networking, and deployment pipelines. Partner with Security and Compliance teams to implement cloud governance, encryption, access control, vulnerability management, and audit requirements. Evaluate technical debt and operational toil, then prioritize automation and architectural improvements that reduce risk and improve engineering efficiency. Create technical designs, operational documentation, implementation plans, runbooks, and support procedures. Lead technical initiatives with limited supervision and communicate risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and progress clearly to stakeholders. Review infrastructure code and technical designs while mentoring less-experienced engineers. Participate in production support and incident response activities, including root cause analysis and follow-up remediation. Required Qualifications At least five years of professional engineering experience, including three or more years focused on cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, or site reliability engineering. Strong hands-on experience with at least one major public cloud platform—AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud—and working knowledge of multi-cloud infrastructure. Production experience with Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code framework. Hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms and automated infrastructure delivery processes. Experience using Helm to package, configure, and deploy applications or platform components in Kubernetes environments. Experience operating Kubernetes-based platforms and troubleshooting workloads, clusters, networking, and deployment issues. Demonstrated experience migrating legacy systems, manually managed infrastructure, or traditional data center workloads to cloud-based or cloud-native platforms. Strong understanding of cloud networking, IAM, encryption, secrets management, observability, and infrastructure security. Experience supporting production services with defined reliability, availability, performance, and operational requirements. Ability to independently lead technical projects, manage competing priorities, and drive work through production validation. Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, networking, operating systems, automation, and distributed services. Experience reviewing technical designs and mentoring engineers. Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering, product, security, compliance, and operations teams. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Terragrunt, GitLab CI/CD, Argo CD, Teleport, Linkerd, or similar technologies. Experience designing cloud landing zones, account or project provisioning, organizational policies, and cloud governance controls. Experience migrating virtual machine-based services to containerized or Kubernetes-based platforms. Familiarity with cloud cost optimization, capacity management, disaster recovery, and business continuity. Experience supporting SaaS platforms operating across multiple geographic regions and cloud providers. Experience working in PCI, SOC 2, ISO, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or similarly regulated environments. Experience improving legacy Terraform codebases, splitting shared state, introducing reusable modules, and reducing deployment complexity. Experience developing infrastructure automation, platform services, or internal tools using TypeScript or Go. Experience working with globally distributed engineering and operations teams. Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? At Alteryx, we support a growth mindset for our associates through all stages of their careers. If you meet some of the requirements and you share our values, we encourage you to apply. As part of our ongoing commitment to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, we’re invested in building teams with a wide variety of backgrounds, identities, and experiences. This position involves access to software/technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.
